correctness.rationale: The weak planar support-area formula and its bilinear polarization hold for H^1 support functions and furnish exact covariance V=2sum w_{K,n}w_n. The explicit probe satisfies h_K+h_K''≥3/4, and w_{K,n}=(pi/8)4^{-n}(n²−1)/n^4>0 at every n≥2, so V=0 iff the unknown is a translated disk. With z=V/(2cH), split n≤N=floor(log_4(1/z)/2) and n>N. The lower spectral coefficient and the H-weighted tail yield D/H≤(4/3)N²4^{-N}+1/(N+1)²≤4/(N+1)²<16/T² for T≥8. Analytic witness h=1+(2n²)^-1 cos(nφ) has curvature≥1/2 and D/H=1/n² while T=n+O(logn), forcing exponent two. Independent finite mode values and direct quadratic checks corroborate; they are not infinite proofs.
